evidence_status: Historical GPU run; packaging and helper adaptations have not been rerun on GPU.
source_revision_note: The original revision plus the archived task patch; archived source fingerprints below identify the measured implementation exactly.

provenance.raw_retention: Original archives, JSONL, logs and scripts are preserved unchanged outside this PR.
provenance.selection: Backward records are selected from combined forward/backward runs; original combined metadata and summaries remain labeled and unmodified. Forward case measurements belong to the companion forward report.
provenance.sanitization: Only submitted derivatives omit unrelated operational metadata, replace installation/source prefixes, or convert package inventory syntax. All backward measured values and warnings are retained.
helper_adaptations: Require explicit forward/backward task selection instead of defaulting to both.
Use the current checkout revision instead of an optional hidden historical revision file.
Use an equivalent Python 3.10+ union in isinstance for JSON normalization and update the helper docstring.
Keep FP32 oracle arithmetic, corruption construction and production-comparator calls unchanged.

tolerances.rms_rejection_rule: Reject each output when max_abs > 1e-6 and normalized RMS >= its limit.
